nodes.name: When called by a controller
nodes.notes: Expects { date, model, dataset, validation }. The controller workflow calls this once per session date; the same trigger can be called by any future runner.

nodes.name: Normalise call
nodes.notes: Refuses a missing or malformed date, a non-lowercase adapter id, a path outside the repository and an unknown validation label before a shell command is built.

nodes.name: Evaluate one morning
nodes.notes: The controller validates the snapshot, calls the selected Layer 1 adapter and scores the call against the stored outcome. It prints one JSON document and exits non-zero on a malformed argument.

nodes.name: Parse decision
nodes.notes: Turns stdout into one decision item. A refusal becomes an error instead of an empty call, so a blocked morning stays visible.

nodes.name: Return decision
nodes.notes: The caller receives status, call, validation, results and outcomes for this one morning.

parameters.content: Research only. This sub-workflow evaluates a saved morning from a committed research artefact. It reads no provider, writes no warehouse row, places no order and publishes no dashboard call. A green run is not evidence of live deployment, causal feature timing or trading edge.
